text_block_list.text:
I came to watch the race together with 
Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Right now! Leaving everyone else in the 
dust! A truly magnificent GOOOOOALLLL!!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We were supposed to watch the races today, 
but... would you mind if we changed our 
plans?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Basking in all these cheers, I just 
couldn't sit still anymore—
choice_data_list: Let's head back and run right away!
Watching is a form of learning, too.

Afterward, Grass Wonder continued running 
laps late into the night.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list:
Let's make up for it with extra training 
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, understood. Then please, give me 
the extra-large portion.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I shall... burn this race into my memory 
and bring back as much of its fervor as I 
can.

Grass Wonder watched every single race of 
the day with tremendous concentration.
